title: Berkeley admissions paradox, Kruskal's model
content: Figure 9.5 extends the simple admissions model with State of Residence as a cause of both Department and Outcome. Conditioning on Department blocks the mediated path but opens the collider path Gender -> Department <- State of Residence -> Outcome.

variables.name: Gender
variables.content: The applicant attribute whose direct effect is the discrimination question.

variables.name: Department
variables.content: A mediator and collider receiving Gender and State of Residence.

arrows.because: Figure 9.5 retains the direct discrimination path.
State of Residence affects department choice in Kruskal's counterexample.
State of Residence also affects admissions outcome.
